item.title: AI Hardware 2026: NVIDIA H200 vs AMD MI300X vs Google TPU v5 Compared
item.description: Choosing AI hardware in 2026 means navigating a more competitive market than ever before. NVIDIA still holds 80%+ market share thanks to the CUDA ecosystem, but AMD’s MI300X delivers superior memory bandwidth at roughly half the price, while Google’s TPU v5p and AWS Trainium 2 offer vertically integrated economics that can cut inference costs by 30–50%. The right choice depends on your workload, team expertise, and total cost of ownership — not just raw TFLOPS.
